first_impression.summary_in_own_words: It's a guide to getting married in Portugal, sorted by region, and a company called Wedded Concierge will give us one advisor to plan it. Portugal wasn't on our list (we were thinking Italy or Greece) but 'from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff' sounds different and pretty. I'd keep scrolling, but the first thing I want is a price and I'm told up front there won't be one in the hero.

attention_map.quote: Get Married in Portugal, from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff
attention_map.why: Palace or cliff is the 'something different, not a standard package' feeling we want. The quick answer that we can marry there and that lots of couples do a symbolic ceremony and the legal bit at home is genuinely useful. But 'No From price or any cost figure in the hero' means my first question goes unanswered straight away.

attention_map.quote: Which season are you planning for? ... How many guests? ... 'Check your date'
attention_map.why: Three taps, no long form, and I can put in our guest count. That's the kind of thing I'd actually do on my phone at 10pm. I'd want to know what I get back, though, before I hand over my email.

attention_map.quote: a non-numeric line naming Wedded Concierge and one Wedded Advisor, or hide the strip
attention_map.why: If the numbers aren't there it's just a line saying who they are. Doesn't tell me much either way.

attention_map.quote: Fall for Portugal Before You Choose a Venue
attention_map.why: Nice to look at, and I'd show my partner the palace bit. But it's sightseeing. And the Monserrate scaffolding warning, while honest, makes me wonder what else I'd find out late.

attention_map.quote: Setting; Best months; Nearest airport (code); Guests
attention_map.why: This is where I'd stop and actually read. Airports per region helps with 'how do our guests get there'. But the Guests line is left out or says 'Ask your Wedded Advisor', which is exactly the thing I need to know. That's where I start feeling like I'll have to enquire just to find out if it's even possible.

attention_map.quote: Queluz and the National Palace of Sintra can be needed for state events, and events on those dates may have to be cancelled
attention_map.why: Wait, our wedding could be cancelled? That's the opposite of stress-free. Good to know, but it scared me off the palace idea without telling me what happens if it does.

attention_map.quote: visa-free short stays on Australian, US and UK passports ... four arrival airports
attention_map.why: Fine. Reassuring for our guests but I'd skim it.

attention_map.quote: Exclusivity can mean paying for unoccupied rooms; a buy-out is often separate from the venue fee; fees may be per day or per guest with a minimum
attention_map.why: This is exactly my fear about prices starting low and blowing out, and the page confirms it can happen, with no numbers. It feels honest, but it adds worry and no answer.

attention_map.quote: Certificate of No Impediment (CNI) or registry certificates ... statement of eligibility to marry before a consular officer ... FCDO online service
attention_map.why: The Australian bit is relevant and I'd save it for later, but on my phone this tab is a wall of US and UK rules and acronyms. We're a 2 out of 10 on planning; this is where my eyes glaze over. I'd want the advisor to handle this.

attention_map.quote: total EUR 25,000 to 70,000 ... for about 100 guests
attention_map.why: If this shows, it's the single most useful thing on the page. Roughly AUD 40k to 120k-ish for 100 people tells me our budget is in the ballpark. But it's in euros, it's only for 100 guests (we're more like 60), and the brief says the whole tab may show no figures at all until sign-off. If it's the fallback 'what drives cost' version, I've learnt nothing.

attention_map.quote: Venue nights with rooms, welcome dinner, ceremony, long dinner, late party, Sunday brunch, an on-the-day coordinator
attention_map.why: This is the picture I want: a whole weekend with our people. Being told it's not a package but a planned weekend is fine, but with no price next to it I can't tell if it's for us or for people with twice our budget.

attention_map.quote: Quinta rooms first, then nearby hotels ... Transfers from Lisbon or Porto
attention_map.why: Answers where our guests stay and how they get there, in plain terms. Good.
No real weddings here means no proof anyone like us has done this with them in Portugal.

attention_map.quote: Plan Your Portugal Wedding with One Wedded Advisor
attention_map.why: One person from start to finish is what I want, so the time zones aren't my problem. But it's a job title, not a person. No name, no face, the founder quote is gone, and fees are 'explained on the first call'. I don't know who I'd be talking to or what it costs to have them.

attention_map.quote: Is a wedding in Portugal cheaper than at home?
attention_map.why: I'd tap this one first. If the answer dodges a number I'd be annoyed.

attention_map.quote: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's wedding
attention_map.why: Might click out of curiosity, doesn't help us decide.

questions_answered.question: What does this cost all in, and what is included in the from price?
questions_answered.evidence: There is no from price at all: 'No Wedded Wonderland figure and no From AUD price on this page.' The only cost figure is a market range in euros for about 100 guests, and even that is 'Apply only after sign-off', with a no-figures fallback. The weekend section lists what a weekend 'can include' but says it is not an inclusion list or price.

questions_answered.question: Can it fit our guest count?
questions_answered.evidence: Region cards: 'Guests line: no sourced guest range exists. Leave it out ... or Ask your Wedded Advisor'. No venue capacities. The qualifier bar asks my guest count but does not tell me anything back on the page.

questions_answered.question: Who would actually plan this with us, and what do they do?
questions_answered.evidence: 'one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend' and a How it works block. But no named person, founder quote and byline removed, and planner fees only explained on the first call.

questions_answered.question: How do our guests get there and where do they stay?
questions_answered.evidence: Airports per region (LIS, FAO, OPO, FNC), visa-free entry for Australian passports, 'Quinta rooms first, then nearby hotels', 'Transfers from Lisbon or Porto'. No flight times or drive times, though.

questions_answered.question: Is our budget realistic for this place?
questions_answered.evidence: Only if the EUR 25,000 to 70,000 for about 100 guests table goes live. It is in euros, only one guest band, and may be replaced by a no-figures 'what drives cost' fallback. If the fallback ships, this is a no.

objections_triggered.objection: Prices look like they start low and will blow out
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'Exclusivity can mean paying for unoccupied rooms; a buy-out is often separate from the venue fee; fees may be per day or per guest with a minimum' with no figures, plus 'Advise couples to check whether quotes include VAT'

objections_triggered.objection: I don't know if my budget is possible for this many people
objections_triggered.triggered_by: No guest line on the region cards and only an about-100-guest cost band (possibly hidden); nothing for 40 to 80 guests

objections_triggered.objection: Planning from overseas, time zones and suppliers I can't meet
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend' eases it, but the long legal-by-passport tab makes the admin look heavy and the advisor is unnamed

objections_triggered.objection: Every planner's page looks the same
objections_triggered.triggered_by: Region cards and FAQs feel like a guide; the palace rules, beach permits and state-event warning are different and honest, but there are no real weddings to prove it

trust_signals_noticed: Travel from a major airport: airport codes on every region card
Who my planner is and the steps: one Wedded Advisor plus a How it works block (role only, no name)
'Legal and cost details checked October 2026, with sources named in each tab'
An Australian passport section with Smartraveller and the Australian Embassy in Lisbon
Honest warnings (Monserrate scaffolding to Q1 2027, state events) that feel like they are not hiding things
turn_offs_noticed: No price signal from Wedded Wonderland at all; the only figure may be hidden behind sign-off
No guest numbers for any region or venue
Real weddings hidden, so no proof
Legal tab heavy with US and UK detail on a phone
Possible palace cancellation for state events with no reassurance

emotional_response.start: curious and a bit excited; palace or cliff feels different from Bali or Santorini
emotional_response.middle: useful but heavy; the venue charges box and state-event line made me more nervous, not less
emotional_response.end: still don't know if we can afford it for our numbers, or who exactly we'd be talking to

payload.decision_reason: Portugal looks lovely and different, and the airports, guest stay and Australian legal bits are useful, so I'd save it and send it to my partner. But it doesn't meet my bar to enquire: no from price or what's included, no guest numbers for any region, and the advisor is a title, not a person. The only cost range may not even appear. I'd come back on the weekend, and if the numbers still aren't there I'd probably look at Italy pages that show a price.
payload.verbatim_reaction: Okay, palace or cliff, that's cute, and the bit about doing a symbolic ceremony there and signing at home is actually helpful. But where's the price? I scrolled the whole thing and the only number might be some euro range for 100 people. We're about 60 and our budget's around 50 to 60k, and I still have no idea if that works. The region cards don't even say how many guests fit. And then it tells me venues can charge for empty rooms and palaces can cancel us for state events, great, now I'm more stressed. One advisor sounds good but who is it? Saving it, sending it to him, but I'm not filling in a form yet.
